notes.title: Pocket Legend is coming to meet players at two offline events this May!
notes.content:
Pocket Legend is coming to meet players at two offline events this May!


DreamHack Shanghai
(May 16–18)
For the first time, Pocket Legend will be showcased at an offline event in China.
Our participation is being handled by a company called Zempie, so we won’t be able to attend in person this time.
However, we are planning to visit China directly for ChinaJoy in August!
We hope you're looking forward to it!
https://dreamhack.com/dreamhack-shanghai/


PlayX4 2025
(May 22–25)
Last year, Pocket Legend made its debut in the B2B hall,
but this year, we’ll be exhibiting in the B2C hall!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/a4507b76cb0a9266f3fb5580a9b6b437eb460f99.png
Our booth number is D30, located near the Steam Deck Experience Zone.
We’d love for you to stop by and check it out!
https://www.playx4.or.kr/

notes.title: Pocket Legend DEMO v1.03 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/452e2f25b476dcdd4d62ee01eb1c3dba6d100a06.jpg

New Resource: Food
Food has been added as a new player resource.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/ecd96e586432563a8eb803e95f1734f3ef715641.png

Traveling long distances at once consumes a large amount of Food.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/bd07fd39956fe8f74df954e8cc2231ee11fd1d2b.png

Food can be replenished at bonefires.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/918413481a2503b18945b59ce30cf14781b7dbd4.png

If you lack Food, your HP will decrease when moving on the map.


6 New Blitz Items Added
The number of Blitz’s items has increased from 67 to 73.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/904e27a5b40c881dd2f5afcc161eeeec024afb7a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/4ee51ca202cc625be8b3113b12d4b487fc01aa2b.png


 Armor - Shield of Evalach – DEF is doubled
 Two-Hand Grip – Increases fixed weapon DMG (%)
 Precision Shot – Increases weapon DMG (%) against distant enemies (also updated in build)
 Bound - Magic Lamp – Increases fixed weapon DMG
 Bound - White Feather Fan – Increases weapon DMG against distant enemies
 Bound - Hokinaiten – Increases fixed item DMG and DEF



Attribute Changes


 More weapons now have the "Fixed" attribute.
 A new attribute "Durability" has been added.
 The "Vanish" attribute has been removed.



Balance Changes

Enemy HP and attack power have been adjusted.

Item stats and enhancement options have been rebalanced.


Relics


 Unlike before when all relics were general, relics are now divided into Boss Relics and Common Relics.
 9 new relics have been added.



Blitz Character Background Updated
To make Pocket Legend's world more compelling, Blitz's background has been updated:



From a modern-day high school cosplayer → To a guardian of a harbor village in a fantasy world


Terminology Changes
To improve clarity, the following term has been updated:



Retrieve → Discard


New Option

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/f355824653013684bd0e0f88142880e5abbae2e4.png

Added "Return to Title" button to the options menu.

notes.title: Pocket Legend DEMO v1.02 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/5c80f0656cfbfcfbe8c057b552a59d4c0480a113.jpg

Our development team has released the v1.02 update in preparation for Steam Next Fest.
This update includes the following changes:


 New cards added
 Card removals
 Item ability adjustments
 Upgrade ability changes
 Enemy balance adjustments
 Enhancements
 Boss guide


New Cards Added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/474c273803e95c2cd89cf668ea05b2f6055724e8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/df7a4c6b2e5f0ed235e7d7772e15b5495e4f6444.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/4b7f8f7629f50c7d501b9fd9d7f5ba3d027b7659.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/44f537734e2da357c1ae9f1920a01e924af8a3d8.png


Card Removals


 Gran Grimoire
 Book of the Dead

These two items have been removed from the game.



Item Ability Adjustments

Weapons


 Siren – Base attack reduced from 4 → 3.
 Po-shan Qian – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Ame-no-Habakiri – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Trishula – Now occupies 4 slots. All Wraith Pieces are removed, and attack power increases for each piece removed.
 Khryselakatos – Now occupies 3 slots.
 Fail-Not – Attacks based on the number of cards in hand.
 The Sword of Surtr – Increases attack power for the duration of the battle each time a Wraith Piece is generated.
 Pinaka – Now occupies 3 slots. The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Curtana – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Lúin Celtchair – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Gáe Bolg – Healing ability reduced from 3 → 2.
 Tyrfing – Removes all Wraith Pieces, increasing attack power based on the number removed.
 Chandrahas – Now occupies 3 vertical slots.
 Brahmastra – Attack power reduced from 16 → 11.


Armor


 Petasos – Removes all Wraith Pieces and increases defense by the number removed.
 Tarnkappe – Defense increased from 3 → 6, but the ‘Restraint’ trait has been added.
 Ochan – Base defense reduced from 3 → 2, but gains an additional 4 defense when removing a Wraith Piece.
 Ring of Protection – Generates a Wraith Piece and provides 2 defense. The ‘Re-use’ trait has been added.


Skills


 Dual Wield – Functions the same as before but now consumes 3 HP.
 Final Defense – No longer changes the ‘Consume’ trait to ‘Vanish.’
 Final Flame – No longer changes the ‘Consume’ trait to ‘Vanish.’
 Emergency Repair – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added. Now occupies 3 horizontal slots.
 Aparigraha – Now occupies 2 vertical slots. The ‘Restraint’ trait has been added.
 Disrupt Blender – Now occupies 2 vertical slots. The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added.
 Draw Card – No longer draws based on item size but instead draws a fixed number of cards.


Binding


 Caladbolg – The ‘Fixed’ trait has been added. Gains a Duel buff every turn.
 Arondight – The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Talaria – The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Cheonsa-okdae – The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added. Gains 2 defense per Wraith Piece at the end of each turn.
 Philosopher’s Stone – Randomly consumes an item each turn and gains a CounterAttack buff. The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Draupnir – Gains 2 Strength but also receives the Stuck debuff. The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Robe of the Fire-rat – If consumable items are available, gains 2 defense per item. The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Widow’s Cruse – The ‘Oxidizing’ trait has been added.
 Gjallarhorn – The ‘Rapport’ trait has been added.
 Haïdos Kyneē – The ‘Rapport’ trait has been added.




Upgrade Ability Changes


 Almost all items have had their upgrade abilities changed. (There are too many to list—playing the game yourself will be more fun!)
 The ‘Ready’ trait has been largely removed.
 Some items now gain the ‘Regression’ trait when upgraded. (‘Regression’ is a newly introduced trait.)
 Some items now gain the ‘Re-use’ trait when upgraded.



Enemy Balance Adjustments

Balance changes have been made to all enemies in Stages 2 and 3.


Enhancements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/93592424926f3cb021f251871ffa8b8596c670ff.png


 All cards can now be upgraded only three times.
 There is a 20% chance of failure when upgrading.
 The top-right corner of the card will now display upgrade results based on upgrade attempts.
 The cost of upgrading is now fixed at 1, regardless of the upgrade stage.



Boss Guide

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/59e6e9fc9d20d5d3e9936590b5aa3ed76a49d104.png

Hovering over the boss icon in the top-center UI will now display which boss will appear.



This concludes the v1.02 update! We hope you enjoy the new changes and look forward to your feedback. 🎮🔥

notes.title: Pocket Legend v1.01 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/a2298f97ad72b838f3d23626068ccfb342aa3a79.jpg

Pocket Legend DEMO Version 1.01 Update!


Thank you for enjoying the demo version of Pocket Legend!
As we prepare for the Early Access launch, we’ve been working on various quality-of-life improvements and polishing the game.
Some of these updates are included in version 1.01 to share the direction of our development with you.


Quality of Life & Polishing



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/85c29e305970fadfea777aaeff4defb42d6f4f7c.png
- Game Logo Update


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/9230a33191ff83309f0e5b3b0a7b5247d8d54ff8.png
- Resolution: Now supports various resolutions, including widescreen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/4a70f253acf0ec218dc9408f82c0ae94da9af211.png
- Item State Badges Added - Allows players to check the status of various items without mouse-over.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/a725f5f6dec326553a094499ffd550f80725e897.png
- Enemy Intent Improvements: Cards that disrupt enemy plans are now displayed together.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/819d1d5787b4602bf61cd02c14f8eb797160fc98.png
- Inventory Loss FX: Shows which slot was lost when inventory is lost


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/fec01bd4a5d6e65ac6f915847bc8aea10a60b69a.png
- Choice Icons Added & Revised


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/bf8a841a174f9f7362a3f9fbb051141d23b59b0e.png
- HP Bar Delay: When hit, the HP bar decreases with a delay, showing total damage taken.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/503939b149ed7e2504f965b7b5c725ff11e1a23e.png
- Version Display in Options


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/5aef55889517ed6395d650f50270c50381d5c908.png
Seed Display in Game


- Slow Effect on Final Blows: A slow effect is added when enemies receive the final blow

- Story Dialogue Updates: Prevents the same dialogue from repeating when encountering the same enemy in story mode.

- Event Enhancements: Shops and forges now appear in events.

- Sound: Improved sound effect quality / Added BGM for the world map and boss battles.

- Trail Effects for Rewards: Added trail effects when acquiring gold or enhancement stones


--------------------------------------------------------

Balance Changes

- Items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/dc9c7069d58671dfbee30237987742ac4e045e29.png
Gravity-Ignoring Gloves: Items larger than 5 slots have +1 reuse but now vanish after use.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/8913e3a54f71946aa1ee18924ac6c2f93f02f61e.png
Dual Wield: Adds 'Vanish' to the weapon used


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/b85802665cc4c33326ad11085cfcb54f789315a1.png
Trishula: Changed function from removing rage shards to generating them.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/2011e457e370dbdfb8a737484d41cf014047a804.png
Po-shan Qian: Generates rage shards equal to the number of opponents and deals damage to all enemies for each shard created.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/338aa757ad94a18db57426aa1c56270bd5f2d786.png
Petasos: Previously increased agility while generating Wrath Piece; now increases defense instead.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/50c5d26037fd27f5d376be89bfde4b3b62770aee.png
Ochan: Function changed to remove Wrath Piece, granting additional defense when removed.



- Enemies


1. Bajiao Shan: Growth mechanic added / Changed the frequency of obtaining gravel.
2. Liquan Shenqiang: Growth mechanic added (uses skills to increase strength).
3. Nagelring/Hildegrim: Adjusted balance.
4. Ipetam: Adjusted balance.
5. Megingjörð: Increased number of appearances in Stage 3 (from 2 to 3).
6. Andvaranaut: Increased number of appearances in Stage 3 (from 3 to 5).
7. Kestos Himas: Lock buff replaced with a skill.
8. Lorg Mόr: Adjusted balance.
9. Vajra: Increased attack power and generates two disruptions.
10. Gungnir: Gains strength based on enhancement stone values.

notes.title: Dev Vlog: Production Story
notes.content:
Production Story

Hello! This is Shading Box! 

Our project, Pocket Legend, has been in development for nearly three years now, and we thought we’d share our journey with you, and tell you a little bit about us!

We’re a fully remote team of three: myself (the founder), my wife, and our one employee.

[previewyoutube=sIvoQrkQGEo;full][/previewyoutube]
When we first started, Pocket Legend looked very different. Originally, it was an inventory merchant game where you sold items to heroes, as shown in this early screenshot:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/49db1f46f59b536ab1d6c732f2cd0cf943cd1507.png
To make the game more engaging, we added a draw system and turn-based combat, inspired by our love for Slay the Spire. This led us to the current gameplay style you see today:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/9f9b5cbccfb7953f81e34cdad9759e7221811950.png
Fun Fact: The original main character, Carrie, is now an NPC who runs the shop in the current version!

At first, players used basic weapons like leather armor and wooden swords. But since “inventory” is our game’s identity, we wanted each weapon to have its own unique lore and presence. This led us to incorporate legendary weapons and armor from mythology and folklore around the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206366/d2a6178a2e5cf0c21ceb1cd5e359eed6ba4b648a.png
We’ve drawn inspiration from Arthurian legend, Norse mythology, Greek mythology, Chinese legends, Celtic myths, Charlemagne legends, Indian mythology, Japanese folklore, Korean mythology, The Song of the Nibelungs, Dietrich legends, and more.

(If you’re a mythology fan, you’ll enjoy spotting which weapons and enemies appear in each stage!)

We thought it would be fun if these legendary weapons, infused with souls, became the heart of the story—like “Ego Swords.” Each weapon or enemy feels like a “pocket monster” in weapon form. That’s why we chose the name Pocket Legend over common inventory-related terms like “backpack.”

The Current State

The gaming industry in Korea is struggling, and freelance work has largely dried up due to the economic downturn. But we’re holding on, and we’re proud to share that Pocket Legend will enter Early Access next April. We’re doing everything we can to make sure it’s polished and ready for you!

Your support means the world to us and thank you for following us! If you haven’t wishlisted Pocket Legend, we’d greatly appreciate if you did so!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129790/Pocket_Legend__Inventory_Roguelike_Deckbuilding/

We hope you’ll look forward to the Early Access launch next April. Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Pocket Legend demo & a new trailer are finally out!
notes.content:
Pocket Legend demo is now out!

We are excited to announce the official release of Pocket Legend, a one-of-a-kind inventory roguelike deck-building game that will challenge your strategic thinking and immerse you in an epic adventure. Step into the shoes of a protagonist who is mysteriously transported to the world of Lumensia, where legendary weapons infused with powerful souls are waiting to be discovered.

In Pocket Legend, your inventory isn’t just a space to store items—it’s the battleground itself. How you arrange your cards determines your ability to survive and thrive in a world full of powerful enemies. Every turn brings a new opportunity to reorganize your inventory, unlocking unique strategies and synergies that will tip the scales in your favor.

[previewyoutube=sIvoQrkQGEo;full][/previewyoutube]
Key Gameplay Features

Dynamic Inventory Management: Your inventory is the key to victory. Each card has its own unique effect, but its power is influenced by its position within your inventory, the surrounding environment, and various relics.

 Empty spaces around cards can boost their attack power.
 Obstructive blocks in the inventory may provide a surprising advantage, powering up your abilities.
 Constant rearrangement is essential to finding the perfect synergy, as you draw new cards every turn. Adapt your strategy to the evolving battlefield!
Five Card Types:

 Weapons: Deal damage to enemies and tip the scales in your favor.
 Armor: Strengthen your defense to survive the toughest battles.
 Skills: Trigger powerful, instant effects that change the tide of combat.
 Bindings: Provide continuous passive effects as long as they stay in your inventory.
 Obstructions: Disruptive cards that can be created by enemies to complicate your inventory setup.

Legendary Weapons: As you journey through Lumensia, you’ll encounter some of the most legendary weapons in history, each infused with a powerful soul. Equip weapons like Gram, Gae Bolg, Arondight, Leviatein, Tyrfing, and Failnaught to enhance your abilities and change the course of your adventure.

[hr][/hr]
World Concept
The world is filled with Tanebra, powerful enemies that stand in your way. You must use your wits and strategic skills to defeat them and explore the mysteries of this enchanted land. The fate of your protagonist lies in your hands—will you be able to harness the power of the legendary weapons, defeat the Tanebra, and return to your original world?

[hr][/hr]
A Unique Experience
Unlike traditional roguelike or deck-building games where you set your strategy and watch it unfold, Pocket Legend challenges you to think on your feet. The dynamic nature of the inventory system creates a fresh, strategic experience with every battle, making every victory feel earned and every defeat a lesson in growth.

[hr][/hr]
Can You Defeat the Tanebra and Return Home?
Join us on this unforgettable journey in Pocket Legend, where your ability to manage your inventory and combine legendary weapons and relics will determine whether you can defeat the Tanebra and make your way back to your original world.

Ready to take on the challenge? Pocket Legend is available now on Steam, so dive in and start your adventure today!

[hr][/hr]
Share your feedback in the Pocket Legend community hub!
